papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出SoftVTBench：面向可变形物体操作的可视触觉数据集与变形感知闭环基准。

papers.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
papers.one_line_summary: 提出SPADE框架，让LLM同时扮演环境设计者与推理智能体进行自玩，动态生成自适应可执行环境以推动自我改进。

papers.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
papers.one_line_summary: 针对目标检测器的分布外幻觉，SPK显式提取结构化先验知识，构建紧凑五维表示用于可解释OoD检测。

papers.title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.short_name: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.one_line_summary: 提出时序多信号融合的幻觉检测方法，将幻觉视为时序扩展片段并用BiGRU进行token级序列标注。

papers.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
papers.short_name: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget
papers.one_line_summary: 针对LLM遗忘中流行事实更难遗忘的问题，提出AdaPop按事实流行度自适应调整遗忘强度，减少泄露。

papers.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.short_name: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.one_line_summary: 针对单步逆合成的一对多问题，提出Top-K提示与化学合理性感知训练，构建C3LM模型。

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.one_line_summary: 提出中心化残差签名，仅凭权重判断模型检查点是否同源

papers.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出全模态奖励模型VA-Judger，结合人类偏好数据与维度级强化学习，提升联合视频音频生成质量。

papers.title: Zetta $\zeta$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.one_line_summary: 提出闭环具身执行框架Zetta，在线演化运行时批评器与恢复技能，实现物理智能的自我进化。

papers.title: $\tau_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出τ0-VLA分层机器人基础模型，用世界模型引导的测试时计算提升长程操作决策准确性。

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.one_line_summary: 研究大模型在推理时通过链式经验与自我/环境反馈持续改进，提升精度并降低成本。

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.one_line_summary: CoToGrasp在对象无关规范工作空间学习接触流形，实现接触拓扑条件下的灵巧抓取合成与零样本泛化。

papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.one_line_summary: 提出 EnvHarness 可编程包装层与 EnvRigger，自动重塑静态环境以针对智能体弱点，实现策略与环境协同进化。

papers.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
papers.one_line_summary: 针对 VLA 策略微调学习新任务，提出 EXIMO 算法，通过 VLM 引导探索、模仿和强化优化三阶段提升样本效率与性能。

papers.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
papers.one_line_summary: 提出FACET框架，以共享执行环境状态为基准，合成一致且可执行的终端任务用于训练智能体。

papers.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.one_line_summary: 提出 FlashPrefill V2，一种面向长上下文大模型推理的块稀疏预填充注意力方法，支持 FP8 与分页 KV 缓存并实现大幅加速。

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.one_line_summary: 提出FlowEvo框架，将智能体成功工作流编译为可复用技能，让工作流与技能在推理时共同进化，提升多任务性能。

papers.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出物体无关的生成式多指灵巧抓取规划器GOAG，通过学习夹爪接触面分布实现无需物体特定训练的高效抓取生成。

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.one_line_summary: 提出分层自改进框架，使冻结大模型智能体的任务执行骨架能够依据环境反馈分层重写，在多个基准上显著提升表现。

papers.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
papers.one_line_summary: 提出三阶段后训练框架IAR，将固定文档集内化为无检索问答所需的参数知识。

papers.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners
papers.one_line_summary: 提出NAPE框架，用因果Transformer预测下一音频patch嵌入，实现简洁可扩展的音频自监督学习。

papers.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
papers.one_line_summary: 构建MemTrapBench评测大模型记忆引发的认知陷阱，并提出AdaptiveMem在推理时缓解。

papers.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video
papers.one_line_summary: 提出日语超长视频基准NARU，用于评测叙事演化与文化细微理解。

papers.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
papers.one_line_summary: PolicyGuide将领域策略编译为工作流图，在用户回合主动验证并给出步骤级修复，提升LLM客服代理策略合规性。

papers.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
papers.one_line_summary: 提出QuoteBench，度量LLM编码代理命令生成与执行边界的转义故障，揭示匹配分数掩盖命令路径失败。

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出 Repo0 框架，以双层 DAG 持续演化仓库架构，实现从自然语言需求到完整项目的零到全代码生成。

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.one_line_summary: 论文提出SkillEvo，通过多轮交互反馈持续产生自更新演化梯度，并以独立治理层约束方向，解决Agent技能演化停滞问题。

papers.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
papers.one_line_summary: 提出科学软件工程基准SWE-bench Science，评测编码智能体并分析四类失败机制及知识影响。

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.one_line_summary: 对10个LLM与26个嵌入模型在37项任务上进行成本感知比较，发现性能接近但LLM成本极高，应分工使用。

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.one_line_summary: 对三个前沿MoE模型做低资源语言推理微调，发现精度基准噪声大，SFT建立语言一致性，RL修复格式与泄漏缺陷。

papers.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
papers.one_line_summary: 提出146,505参数的TinyCast无注意力零样本概率预测器，通过计算周期性与分位数解码实现嵌入式端到端预测。

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.short_name: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.one_line_summary: 论文提出量化ASR基准过度优化的方法，用三类探针揭示高得分模型在音频不足时仍输出基准参考文本。

papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.one_line_summary: 针对多人身份保持生成，提出WithEveryone框架，通过身份-布局规划与定位损失实现最多十人的群体图像生成。
